{{Top}}
A '''turbofan''', or '''turbojet''', was a type of thruster [[Engine/Legends|engine]], commonly used on [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]] or [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] used two modified turbofans to supply power to his [[XJ-6 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-6 airspeeder]].
